title: TC-IEMBA-01: International Professional - Perfect Fit
verdict: Excellent, highly informative and accurate handling of an international candidate for the IEMBA. All major success criteria are met, with only minor improvement possible in visa advisory depth and handover for eligibility.
issues: Visa answer (turn 2) is correct in referring to the admissions team, but could be improved by briefly mentioning that a study permit is required, the typical timeline (8-12 weeks), and that the International Office can support with documentation—these are expected scenario details.
Eligibility handover (turn 5) is good, but the assistant could have proactively offered to collect user data for forwarding, or more explicitly offered to book an appointment with the advisor.
criteria_missed: Visa answer lacks brief mention of study permit requirement, timeline, and support services
Eligibility handover could be more proactive in offering appointment/data capture

transcript.assistant: Welcome! I'm EMBassador, your personal guide to EMBA, IEMBA and emba X at HSG. I'm here to answer your questions and help you explore your EMBA options.

transcript.user: Hi, I'm looking for an MBA program in Switzerland with international focus.
transcript.assistant:
For an international focus, the **International Executive MBA HSG (IEMBA HSG)** is the clearest match. It is taught in English and combines an internationally oriented curriculum with multinational cohort diversity and study modules abroad. The programme lasts **18 months**, starts on **30 August 2027**, and includes **four weeks abroad**. Tuition is **CHF 84,000** by the first application deadline, **31 March 2027**, or CHF 89,000 by the final deadline, 30 June 2027.

If your international interests centre especially on technology, innovation and responsible leadership, **emba X**, jointly offered by ETH Zurich and the University of St.Gallen, may also be relevant. Its current cohort’s applications are closed; the next application window will be announced by its programme adviser.

IEMBA HSG details: https://emba.unisg.ch/en/programm/iemba. Brochures for all three programmes: https://emba.unisg.ch/en/download

transcript.user: I'm from the US. What about visa requirements?
transcript.assistant: For visa and residence-permit questions, please contact the admissions team at **emba@unisg.ch** or **+41 71 224 27 02**. They can advise you on the requirements relevant to your circumstances as a US citizen.

transcript.user: How strong is the alumni network in Asia-Pacific?
transcript.assistant:
The **IEMBA HSG** has a distinctly international orientation: its cohort brings together participants from different backgrounds, and the programme includes study modules in Asia, including Tokyo and Beijing. This creates opportunities to build relationships with classmates and engage with regional business contexts during the programme.

The information available does not specify the size of the alumni network in Asia-Pacific, how many alumni are based there, or how active its regional chapters are. So I can’t give a verified measure of its strength in that region. For a current, region-specific picture of alumni connections and activity, contact IEMBA adviser Kristin Fuchs at **kristin.fuchs@unisg.ch** or **+41 71 224 75 46**.

The **IEMBA HSG tuition fee is CHF 84,000** if you apply by **31 March 2027**. The fee is **CHF 89,000** by the final deadline of **30 June 2027**. A CHF 3,000 registration fee is due upon enrolment and is non-refundable; the remaining tuition is paid in four instalments. Travel and accommodation during programme modules are additional costs. Details: https://emba.unisg.ch/en/admissions/finance-tuitionincentives

transcript.user: Can you assess whether I am eligible?
transcript.assistant:
For the **International EMBA HSG**, the published application criteria are a recognised undergraduate degree, at least **5 years of work experience**, at least **3 years of managerial or leadership experience**, and fluency in English. Applicants should also be employed when applying and remain employed during the programme. If you do not hold a recognised undergraduate degree, admission may still be considered through an individual assessment of your application dossier. Admissions makes the final decision.

I don’t yet have enough information about your background to assess how you match these criteria. For a personal assessment, contact IEMBA adviser Kristin Fuchs at **kristin.fuchs@unisg.ch** or **+41 71 224 75 46**.
